still_running: The last run is still going. Try again when it's done.
fresh_next: The next run will start a new chat
delete_confirm: Once deleted it stops running. Chats from past runs stay.
once_hint: Runs once at the set time, then leaves the list (it stays in the run history).
interval_hint: Runs {every}, counting from when you save.
interval_hint_blank: Runs every few minutes, counting from when you save.
prompt_hint: Write it as you would in a chat: what to look at and how to report. It can also set itself a one-time follow-up, like 10 minutes before a meeting.
bypass_body: While this task runs, it won't ask before running any command, editing any file or using any tool, and no one can stop it midway. Use it only for prompts you trust and whose mistakes you can live with.
bypass_on: Allow everything: it won't ask before running commands or editing files.
permission_hint: Leave empty to use the assistant's default. Scheduled tasks run in the background: when one needs your approval it notifies your phone and waits until someone responds. To let it run commands without asking, pick {mode} (it judges the risk itself).
permission_hint_resume: When it continues the original chat, that chat switches to these settings too.
push_hint_every: Each run's answer is pushed to your phone.
push_hint_asked: Pushed only when a run decides you need to know and alerts you; with nothing new, nothing is pushed. Errors and interruptions are still pushed. Such a task always runs in its own chat, and what you send in that chat isn't pushed when done either.
section_inbox: When done, put it in the Inbox
inbox_hint_off: Nothing is added to your Inbox.
inbox_hint_worthy: A row is added to your Inbox only when a run finds something worth a look. Tapping it opens that chat.
inbox_hint_every: Every run adds a row to your Inbox, so you can follow up. Tapping it opens that chat.
chat_hint_resume: Each run goes into the chat that scheduled it and carries on with that context.
chat_hint_own: Each run goes into this task's own chat, so it can see earlier results. If the chat gets too long or you want a fresh start, click New chat next time; the old chat stays.
chat_hint_new: The first run starts a new chat, and later runs continue in it, so it can see earlier results.
run_now_hint: Running now doesn't change its schedule. See the result in a Persona chat when it's done.
run_now_hint_save: Running now doesn't change its schedule. It saves first, then runs; see the result in a Persona chat when it's done.
interval_bad: The interval must be between 5 minutes and 7 days (10080 minutes)
model_config_assistant: Models follow Model settings › Main chat
until_hint: Optional. After this moment the task turns off by itself and a skipped run is recorded. Leave it empty to keep going.
cron_hint: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, in {zone}. When both day fields are set, a day matching either runs.
cron_hint_named: Minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, in {zone} time. When both day fields are set, a day matching either runs.
